title: 第19章 震动第20章 无头将士
content_zh:
第19章 震动
刘烨缓缓地跟在尤莉身后，欣赏着她那妖娆动人的身姿，系统公告他们这些NPC是不会太关心的，但是作为正义之师的二把手，刘烨相当的关心。
正如自己所想的那样，按照自己的攻略，正义之师成功拿下了副本记录！
公会频道里早已经炸成一锅粥，会员们一个比一个激动，毕竟是件扬眉吐气的事情。
刚刚从副本出来的勇者无敌小队许久才反应过来，一个个老泪横流，他们正义之师终于要雄起了！
“跟班兄弟，我们真的成功了！副本记录真的是我们正义之师！”勇者无敌兴奋的说道。
“应该的……，儿郎们抓紧刷公会任务，在日落之前将公会升到2级，准备收人！”刘烨一声令下，整个公会立刻全体动员起来，如今跟班二号在正义之师已经成了会员们的信仰，他的命令就是神的旨意，特别是在这种扬眉吐气的时候，会员们很乐意去刷公会任务。
“跟班兄弟，按照约定，以后正义之师就交给你打理了！大家都是贫民散人玩家，聚集在一起就是为了反抗邪恶势力，我相信自己的眼光，跟班兄弟一定不会让我们失望的！”勇者无敌说道。
公会频道里立刻多出了无数叫好的声音，所有人都赞同刘烨接替会长的位置，在刘烨看来，眼前的正义之师就是一个完全民主的公会，这样一群热血的儿郎，自己怎么能够辜负他们，在自己回归紫罗兰之前，必定要将正义之师打造成华夏区的大公会。
“既然大家如此相信我，那我就不推辞了，以后大家一起努力，封神的历史由我们来创造！”刘烨威武的大喝一声，接受了勇者无敌的会长委任。
这一刻开始，刘烨正式成为正义之师的会长，这个刚刚建立起来的小公会，在自己明确的指引下，一定可以干出一番作为！
…………
由华东财团资助的东风再起公会，正在副本中奋斗的五位精英成员全都瞪大了眼睛，见钱眼开和圣火也在其中，看到系统公告后，见钱眼开忍不住怒骂起来：“该死的，竟然是那群野人！”
“老大，怎么办？这副本还刷不刷？”圣火问道。
见钱眼开脸色难看的说道：“刷，为什么不刷？这个正义之师本少爷跟他们没完，15级副本记录已经被占了，开始准备20级副本吧？”
“20级副本我们有把握吗？”
见钱眼开冷笑一声说道：“我哥正在做隐藏职业任务，只要他转职成功，以他的操作技术，我们的把握会很大！”
“啊~！大少爷真是厉害，这么快就遇到了隐藏职业！”声旁的众人齐齐惊呼。
…………
话说枫叶林这边，叶夫人和大小姐的脸色难看无比，本以为有隐藏职业加入后，他们的把握会增加一些，可是没想到忽然间杀出一个正义之师！

“雨轩，这个正义之师是什么来历？”叶夫人傲人的胸脯剧烈起伏，脸色阴冷无比。
“没听说过！”大小姐摇头皱眉。
闻言，两人将目光看向月落和乌啼两人，却见两人同样一头雾水，显然没有听说过这样一个游戏公会。
这个时候，叶雨蝶眉头一皱，说道：“正义之师我好像在哪里听说过？”
“雨蝶知道些什么？”众人的目光立刻聚集在叶雨蝶身上。
“咱家二号不是还没有公会吗？今天我本来想拉他进来的，没想到他已经有公会了，就是这个叫做正义之师的公会！”小丫头气哼哼的说道。
“二号是谁？”叶夫人疑惑道。
只见大小姐冷哼一声，说道：“是雨蝶刚找来的一个小跟班，明天刚好找他询问正义之师的情况！”
“嗯！”叶夫人轻轻点头，对于一个跟班，并没有太过在意，“大家先把副本完成，开始准备20级副本吧！”
…………
刘烨在公会频道里大肆煽情片刻，便以练级为由退出了公会频道，专心的跟在尤莉身后，随手清理着四周的亡灵系怪物，经验条在不知不觉中涨到了14级。
时间再次过去半个小时，但是关于正义之师的话题依然热火朝天，各大公会都将目光聚集在这个不起眼的小公会身上，世界频道的刷新仍在继续，游戏论坛也在帖子横飞……
总之，正义之师这个名字算是一炮打红了！
刘烨倒是悠闲自在，作为公会会长，只要分配任务就行，收人和发展公会这些事情交给勇者无敌他们就可以了，自己当前的目标就是努力练级。
如今的刘烨已经不再迷茫，他不会辜负手下一帮兄弟的期望，正义之师这个名字必然会像紫罗兰那样璀璨，这是他对正义之师的承诺！
在本尊渡天劫之前，自己一定要将正义之师发展起来，两家公会合力，绝对可以问鼎封神世界，到时候，什么毒龙工会？什么龙临异世？顺我者昌逆我者亡！
“等等。”
就在刘烨意－淫的时候，前方的尤莉忽然停了下来，凝重的注视着前方。
那是一座白骨皑皑的小山丘，山丘上有一口深邃的洞穴，两名亡灵骑士忠实的守在洞口，**的亡灵战马幽光闪动，散发着威武、死亡和杀气……
“就是这个地方吗？”刘烨低声问道。

尤莉凝重的点头，说道：“老师觉察到的波动就是来自这个山洞，这两个亡灵骑士很厉害，至少有20级的实力，我可以轻松对付一个，你现在才14级，上去只能找死！”
“小看我是不是？哥可是无所不能的！”刘烨不爽的说道。
“自大的家伙，都什么时候了？”尤莉不满道。
“不相信是吧？那好，我们一人一个，我要是赢了你就答应我一个要求，敢不敢？”刘烨坏坏的笑道。
尤莉顿时羞愤不已，恶狠狠的说道：“有什么不敢的？本姑娘已经21级了！”
“那好，我右边的，你左边的！”刘烨心中冷笑，这两个亡灵骑士明显是准BOSS，等级都是20级，不过通过刘烨的仔细观察，左边的属性明显要比右边强一点。
“好，开始！”尤莉气鼓鼓的瞪了刘烨一眼，开启冲锋朝着左边的亡灵骑士杀过去。
刘烨咧嘴一笑，御剑术直催动，鬼王剑化作一道流光，远远的收割着亡灵骑士的生命，自己的等级虽然比不上尤莉，但是自己怎么说也是隐藏职业，属性本来就有优势，更何况，自己的攻速比她快多了！
嗖——嗖——嗖——
御剑术在亡灵骑士身上来回穿插，一道道伤害在亡灵骑士头顶升起，好在亡灵骑士的物防不怎么样，生命值哗哗的往下走，驾驭着亡灵战马向自己这边冲过来。
“有坐骑了不起啊？”刘烨玩味一笑，御剑术的持续时间还有3秒，亡灵骑士的生命已经少了一半，眼看亡灵骑士已经冲过来，刘烨立刻发动冲锋，将其眩晕。
怒斩——“－173”
剑气斩——“－204”
“－151”
“暴击－298”
亡灵骑士的生命支线下降，再看尤莉那边，等级高也是有优势的，轮舞剑和弧光斩这两个技能的攻击很高，竟然和自己不相上下？
尤莉一边攻击一边诧异的看向跟班二号，心中震惊不已，自己已经21级了，而且自己身上的装备都是20级的精良装备，竟然跟一个14级的小流氓打成平手？
“怎么可能？这小子的攻速这么快！”尤莉很快便发现了原因，自己的攻击力比他高，但是自己攻击两次，跟班二号就能攻击三次。
这样下来，自己竟然和他拉开了差距……
“嘿嘿！”

刘烨得意的大笑一声，亡灵骑士已经挣脱了眩晕束缚，手中的骑士重剑笨拙的向跟班二号砸过来。
轻松一个侧翼跳跃，刚好躲开重剑攻击，一剑砍在亡灵骑士腰上，“－147”
在跟班二号的折磨下，亡灵骑士的生命迅速下降到5%，进入红血状态，疯狂的挥舞重剑。
系统提示：亡灵骑士使用技能狂暴剑舞，对5*5范围内造成120%物理伤害+60点暗属性伤害……
刘烨只感觉脑袋一疼，头顶飘起一道伤害数字：“－315”
奶奶的，范围攻击就是麻烦，好在这个时候冲锋刚好冷却完毕，开启冲锋以后，再次将其眩晕，剑气斩+怒斩落下，刚好打空了亡灵骑士的生命。
“嗷~！”
系统提示：杀死亡灵骑士－20级，获得经验80W点，获得声望25点，金币12枚……
几秒钟以后，尤莉那边才传来BOSS的哀号声，刘烨得意万分，看样子自己是赢了！
亡灵骑士的经验还算丰厚，让自己直接踏入了15级的层次，不过刘烨最在意的还是亡灵骑士掉落的物品，铜币堆里一把黝黑的长剑引让刘烨眼前一亮，奶奶的，终于可以换武器了：
【精准的亡灵长剑】（紫色装备）
等级：15
耐久度：148/148
基础属性：物理攻击+82、魔法攻击+45
附加属性：力量+3、敏捷+3
属性不错的长剑，刚好给自己使用，不过让刘烨失望的是，亡灵骑士只爆出一件装备，其他的都是一些杂七杂八的材料和银币，唯一可以看得上眼的就是一张15级的暴击强化卷轴了。
目前自己身上能够用得上的也就这把15级的紫色武器了，没有丝毫的犹豫，直接把强化卷轴用在了亡灵长剑上面：
【精准的亡灵长剑】（紫色装备）
等级：15
耐久度：148/148

基础属性：物理攻击+82、魔法攻击+45
附加属性：力量+3、敏捷+3
强化属性（1/1）：暴击+1
强化之后，亡灵长剑已经变成了+1暴击的极品属性了，美滋滋的换在身上，把鬼王剑丢进公会仓库，在公会里引起了很大的震动，现阶段的紫色武器可是很吃香的，虽然鬼王剑只有6级。
装备亡灵长剑之后，跟班二号的属性已经不同往日：
ID：跟班二号
职业：九转剑仙
等级：15
声望：160
称号：【拜亚足迹－1级】
生命值：925
魔法值：730
物理攻击：178－212
魔法攻击：87
物防：84
魔防：40
速度：28
攻速：5
命中：57
闪避：49

暴击率：7%
魅力：2
幸运：1
这样的属性当真可以用变态来形容了，刘烨得意的回过神来，只见尤莉MM正复杂的看着自己，那目光中充满了不可思议和不甘心，还有许多说不出的情绪……

content_en:
Chapter 19 Shock
Liu Ye slowly followed Youli, admiring her enchanting figure. The system announced that NPCs like them would not care too much, but as the second-in-command of the Master of Justice, Liu Ye was quite concerned.
Just as he thought, according to his strategy, the Master of Justice successfully won the dungeon record!
The guild channel has already exploded into a mess. Every member is more excited than the other. After all, it is a matter of pride and pride.
The brave and invincible team who had just come out of the dungeon took a long time to realize that they were all in tears. Their righteous army was finally about to rise!
"Brothers, we really succeeded! The copy record is really our righteous master!" The brave man said excitedly.
"That's right... boys, hurry up and complete the guild missions, upgrade the guild to level 2 before sunset, and prepare to recruit people!" Liu Ye gave the order, and the entire guild immediately mobilized. Now Follower No. 2 has become the belief of the members in the Justice Division. His orders are God's will. Especially at this time of pride, the members are happy to complete the guild missions.
"Follower brother, according to the agreement, you will be in charge of the army of justice from now on! We are all poor individual players, and we gather together to resist the evil forces. I believe in my own vision, and the follower brother will not let us down!" said the brave man.
Immediately there were countless applause voices in the guild channel. Everyone agreed with Liu Ye to take over the position of president. In Liu Ye's view, the Master of Justice in front of him was a completely democratic guild. How could he let down such a group of passionate men? Before he returned to Violet, he must build the Master of Justice into the great guild in China.
"Since everyone believes in me so much, I won't refuse. From now on, everyone will work together, and we will create the history of becoming a god!" Liu Ye gave a mighty shout and accepted the appointment as the president of the Brave Invincible.
From this moment on, Liu Ye officially became the president of the Master of Justice. This newly established small guild will definitely be able to accomplish great things under his clear guidance!
…………
The five elite members of the East Wind Rises Guild funded by the East China Consortium who were fighting in the dungeon all had their eyes widened. Jian Qianyankai and Shenghuo were among them. After seeing the system announcement, Jianqian Yankai couldn't help but cursed angrily: "Damn it, it's those barbarians!"
"Boss, what should I do? Do you still need to clear this copy?" Sheng Huo asked.
Seeing Qian's eyes widened, he said with an ugly face: "Swipe, why not? This master of justice, Master Ben, is not done with them. The record of the level 15 dungeon has been occupied. Let's start preparing for the level 20 dungeon?"
"Are we sure about the level 20 dungeon?"
Seeing Qian's eyes, he sneered and said: "My brother is doing a hidden career mission. As long as he successfully transfers his job, with his operating skills, we will be very sure!"
"Ah~! The eldest young master is really amazing. He encountered a hidden profession so quickly!" Everyone around him exclaimed in surprise.
…………
Speaking of Maple Leaf Forest, Mrs. Ye and the eldest lady looked extremely ugly. They thought that after the hidden profession joined, their confidence would increase, but they did not expect that a righteous master suddenly appeared!
"Yuxuan, what is the origin of this Master of Justice?" Mrs. Ye's proud chest rose and fell violently, and her face was extremely cold.
"Never heard of it!" The eldest lady shook her head and frowned.
Hearing this, the two looked at Yueluo and Wuwei, but they saw that they were equally confused. They had obviously never heard of such a gaming guild.
At this time, Ye Yudie frowned and said, "Where have I heard of the Master of Justice?"
"What does Yudie know?" Everyone's eyes immediately focused on Ye Yudie.
"Don't our No. 2 have a guild yet? I originally wanted to bring him in today, but I didn't expect that he already has a guild.There is a guild, and it is this guild called the Master of Justice! "The little girl said angrily.
"Who is number two? "Mrs. Ye said doubtfully.
The eldest lady snorted coldly and said, "It's a little follower that Yudie just found. I'm going to ask him about the situation of the Master of Justice tomorrow! "
"Um! Mrs. Ye nodded lightly, not paying too much attention to a follower, "Everyone, please complete the dungeon first and start preparing for the level 20 dungeon!" "
…………
Liu Ye made a fuss in the guild channel for a moment, then exited the guild channel on the pretext of leveling up. He followed Youli intently, cleaning up the undead monsters around him, and the experience bar rose to level 14 without even realizing it.
Half an hour has passed again, but the topic about the Master of Justice is still in full swing. All the major guilds have focused their attention on this inconspicuous little guild. The refresh of the world channel is still continuing, and the game forum is also full of posts...
In short, the name Master of Justice became an instant hit!
Liu Ye is leisurely and at ease. As the guild leader, he only needs to assign tasks. He can leave the recruitment and development of the guild to Brave Invincible. His current goal is to work hard to level up.
Today, Liu Ye is no longer confused. He will not let down the expectations of his brothers. The name "Master of Justice" will definitely shine like violets. This is his promise to "Master of Justice!"
Before I go through the Heavenly Tribulation, I must develop the Master of Justice. Together, the two guilds can definitely aspire to dominate the world of gods. When the time comes, what kind of Poison Dragon Guild will there be? What kind of dragon comes to another world? Those who follow me will prosper, those who go against me will perish!
"Wait. "
Just when Liu Ye was lustful, Yuli in front suddenly stopped and stared solemnly ahead.
It was a bone-capped hill. There was a deep cave on the hill. Two undead knights loyally guarded the entrance of the cave. The naked undead horses flashed with light, exuding might, death and murderous aura...
"Is this the place? Liu Ye asked in a low voice.
Yuli nodded solemnly and said: "The fluctuation that the teacher noticed came from this cave. These two undead knights are very powerful. They are at least level 20. I can easily deal with one of them. You are only level 14 now. If you go up there, you will only seek death!" "
"You're looking down on me, aren't you? Brother is omnipotent! Liu Ye said unhappily.
"Arrogant guy, since when? "Yuli said dissatisfied.
"You don't believe it, do you? Okay, let's take it one by one. If I win, you will agree to my request. Do you dare? Liu Ye said with a wicked smile.
Yuli was immediately ashamed and angry, and said viciously: "What are you afraid of? This girl is already level 21! "
“Okay then, the one on my right, the one on your left! "Liu Ye sneered in his heart. These two undead knights are obviously quasi-BOSSs, both at level 20. However, through Liu Ye's careful observation, the attributes on the left side are obviously stronger than those on the right side.
"Okay, start! "Youli glared at Liu Ye angrily, then started charging towards the undead knight on the left.
Liu Ye grinned, and activated his sword control skills. The Ghost King Sword turned into a stream of light, harvesting the lives of the undead knights from a distance. Although his level was not as good as Yuli's, he was a hidden profession, and his attributes had inherent advantages. What's more, his attack speed was much faster than hers!
Whoosh—whoosh—whoosh—
The sword control technique went back and forth on the undead knight, and a series of damage rose above the undead knight's head. Fortunately, the undead knight's physical defense was not very good, and his health points went down. He drove the undead war horse towards him.
“Isn’t it great to have a mount? "Liu Ye smiled playfully. The sword control lasted for 3 seconds, and the undead knight's life had been reduced by half. Seeing that the undead knight had rushed over, Liu Ye immediately launched a charge and stunned him.
Angry slash - "-173"
Sword Qi Slash——“-204”
"-151"
"Crit-298"
The undead knight's life branch has dropped. Looking at Yuri, a high level also has advantages. The two skills of Rondo Sword and Arc Slash have very high attacks, and they are on par with her?
Yuli looked at Follower No. 2 in surprise while attacking. She was shocked. She was already level 21, and the equipment on her body was all level 20 sophisticated equipment. How could she be tied with a level 14 hooligan?
"How is that possible? This guy's attack speed is so fast! "Youli soon discovered the reason. Her attack power was higher than his, but if she attacked twice, Follower No. 2 could attack three times.
After doing this, I actually opened a gap between myself and him...
"Hey! "
Liu Ye laughed proudly. The undead knight had broken free from the shackles of the stun, and the knight's heavy sword in his hand clumsily hit the follower No. 2.
He jumped easily on the side, just in time to avoid the heavy sword attack, and struck the undead knight on the waist with one sword, "-147"
Under the torture of Follower No. 2, the undead knight's life quickly dropped to 5%, entered a red blood state, and waved the heavy sword crazily.
System prompt: The undead knight uses the skill of violent sword dance, causing 120% physical damage + 60 points of dark attribute damage within a 5*5 range...
Liu Ye only felt a pain in his head, and a damage number floated above his head: "-315"
Damn it, range attacks are troublesome. Fortunately, the charge has just finished cooling down at this time. After starting the charge, it will be stunned again, and the sword energy slash + fury slash will fall, which just kills the life of the undead knight.
"Ouch~! "
System prompt: Kill the undead knight - level 20, gain 80W experience points, gain 25 reputation points, and 12 gold coins...
A few seconds later, the BOSS's wail came from Yuli's side. Liu Ye was extremely proud, it seemed that he had won!
The experience of the undead knight is quite rich, allowing him to directly enter the 15th level. However, what Liu Ye cares about the most is the items dropped by the undead knight. A dark long sword in the pile of copper coins made Liu Ye's eyes light up. Grandma, he can finally change weapons:
[Precise Undead Long Sword] (purple equipment)
Level: 15
Durability: 148/148
Basic attributes: physical attack +82, magic attack +45
Additional attributes: Strength +3, Agility +3
The long sword with good attributes was just for him to use, but to Liu Ye's disappointment, the Undead Knight only released one piece of equipment, and the others were miscellaneous materials and silver coins. The only one he could look at was a level 15 critical strike enhancement scroll.
At present, the only level 15 purple weapon that I can use is this level 15 purple weapon. Without any hesitation, I directly used the strengthening scroll on the undead sword:
[Precise Undead Long Sword] (purple equipment)
Level: 15
Durability: 148/148
Basic attributes: physical attack +82, magic attack +45
Additional attributes: Strength +3, Agility +3
Enhanced attributes (1/1): Critical hit +1
After strengthening, the Undead Sword has become a top-quality attribute with +1 critical hit. I was happy to have it on my body and threw the Ghost King Sword into the guild warehouse, which caused a great shock in the guild. Purple weapons are very popular at this stage, although the Ghost King Sword is only level 6.
After equipping the Undead Sword, the attributes of Follower No. 2 are different from those of the past:
ID: Follower No. 2
